name: Spellcasting
desc: Cast spells from your class list using your spellcasting ability.

name: Extra Attack
desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

name: Extra Attack (2)
desc: Attack three times when you take the Attack action.

name: Extra Attack (3)
desc: Attack four times when you take the Attack action.

name: Fighting Style
desc: Adopt a fighting style (Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Fighting, Protection, Interception).

name: Additional Fighting Style
desc: Choose a second fighting style.

name: Expertise
desc: Double your proficiency bonus for two chosen skills.

name: Magical Tinkering
desc: Give a Tiny object a light, message, sound or image property.

name: Infuse Item
desc: Infuse items with magic: Enhanced Defense (+1 AC), Enhanced Weapon (+1), Enhanced Arcane Focus (+1 spell attacks), Repeating Shot, Radiant Weapon.

name: The Right Tool for the Job
desc: Create a set of artisan's tools in an hour.

name: Tool Expertise
desc: Double proficiency on tool checks.

name: Flash of Genius
desc: Reaction: add your INT modifier to a failed save or check of a creature within 30 ft. INT mod uses per long rest. (Used automatically when it turns a failure into a success.)

name: Spell-Storing Item
desc: Store a 1st or 2nd level artificer spell in an item.

name: Soul of Artifice
desc: +1 to saves per attuned item; cheat death by ending an infusion.

name: Experimental Elixir
desc: Create random magical elixirs after a long rest.

name: Alchemical Savant
desc: Add INT modifier to one healing or acid/fire/necrotic/poison damage roll of your artificer spells.

name: Arcane Armor
desc: Your armor becomes your spellcasting focus and can't be removed against your will.

name: Armor Model
desc: Guardian: Thunder Gauntlets (1d8 thunder, target has disadvantage attacking others). Infiltrator: Lightning Launcher (1d6 lightning ranged, +1d6 once per turn), +5 ft speed.

name: Eldritch Cannon
desc: Action: create a magical cannon (Flamethrower, Force Ballista or Protector) that acts when you command it. Once per long rest free.

name: Arcane Firearm
desc: Add 1d8 to one damage roll of your artificer spells.

name: Explosive Cannon
desc: Cannon damage rolls gain +1d8; detonate it as an action.

name: Battle Ready
desc: Martial weapon proficiency; use INT for attack and damage with magic weapons.

name: Steel Defender
desc: A loyal construct fights beside you (AC 15, Force-Empowered Rend, Deflect Attack).

name: Arcane Jolt
desc: When your magic weapon or defender hits, deal +2d6 force or heal a creature 2d6. INT mod uses per long rest.

name: Rage
desc: Bonus action: advantage on STR checks/saves, bonus damage on STR melee attacks, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Lasts 1 minute.

name: Unarmored Defense
desc: Without armor, AC = 10 + DEX + CON (shield allowed).

name: Reckless Attack
desc: Advantage on STR melee attacks this turn; attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

name: Danger Sense
desc: Advantage on DEX saving throws.

name: Fast Movement
desc: +10 ft speed when not wearing heavy armor.

name: Feral Instinct
desc: Advantage on initiative rolls.

name: Brutal Critical
desc: Roll extra weapon damage dice on a critical hit.

name: Relentless Rage
desc: While raging, a CON save (DC 10, +5 each use) keeps you at 1 HP.

name: Frenzy
desc: While raging, make a weapon attack as a bonus action each turn.

name: Bear Totem Spirit
desc: While raging, resistance to all damage except psychic.

name: Wolf Totem Spirit
desc: While raging, allies have advantage on melee attacks against hostile creatures within 5 ft of you.

name: Divine Fury
desc: While raging, your first weapon hit each turn deals 1d6 + half your barbarian level radiant damage.

name: Ancestral Protectors
desc: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.

name: Bardic Inspiration
desc: Bonus action: give an ally an inspiration die (d6, growing to d12). It is added to their next failed attack roll or saving throw when it would help.

name: Jack of All Trades
desc: Add half proficiency to checks you aren't proficient in (including initiative).

name: Song of Rest
desc: Allies regain extra HP during a short rest.

name: Font of Inspiration
desc: Bardic Inspiration recovers on a short rest.

name: Cutting Words
desc: Reaction: subtract an inspiration die from an enemy's attack roll. Used automatically when it would turn a hit into a miss.

name: Magical Secrets
desc: Learn spells from any class list.

name: Channel Divinity
desc: Channel divine energy: 1 use per short rest (2 at 6th, 3 at 18th).

name: Turn Undead
desc: Action: undead within 30 ft make a WIS save or are turned for 1 minute.

name: Destroy Undead
desc: Low-CR undead that fail against Turn Undead are destroyed.

name: Disciple of Life
desc: Healing spells restore an extra 2 + spell level HP.

name: Preserve Life
desc: Channel Divinity: distribute 5 x cleric level HP among allies within 30 ft (up to half their max).

name: Warding Flare
desc: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against you. WIS mod uses per long rest.

name: Radiance of the Dawn
desc: Channel Divinity: enemies within 30 ft make a CON save, 2d10 + cleric level radiant (half on success).

name: Eyes of Night
desc: Darkvision 300 ft that you can share with allies.

name: Vigilant Blessing
desc: Grant advantage on initiative. (You always enter combat blessed.)

name: Twilight Sanctuary
desc: Channel Divinity: 30 ft aura for 1 minute. Allies ending their turn inside gain 1d6 + cleric level temporary HP.

name: Steps of Night
desc: Bonus action: flying speed in dim light or darkness.

name: Emboldening Bond
desc: Action: bond up to PB creatures. Once per turn a bonded creature adds 1d4 to a failed attack or save (automatic). PB uses per long rest.

name: Implement of Peace
desc: Proficiency in Insight, Performance or Persuasion.

name: Balm of Peace
desc: Channel Divinity: heal each ally within 15 ft for 2d6 + WIS (simplified from moving through allies).

name: Protective Bond
desc: Bonded creatures can teleport to take damage for each other.

name: War Priest
desc: After the Attack action, make a weapon attack as a bonus action. WIS mod uses per long rest.

name: Guided Strike
desc: Channel Divinity: +10 to an attack roll after seeing it miss (automatic).

name: Wrath of the Storm
desc: Reaction when hit in melee: attacker makes a DEX save or takes 2d8 lightning. WIS mod uses per long rest.

name: Blessing of the Forge
desc: Your armor is blessed: +1 AC.

name: Circle of Mortality
desc: Healing a creature at 0 HP uses maximum dice.

name: Path to the Grave
desc: Channel Divinity: the next attack against a creature deals double damage.

name: Divine Strike (Radiant)
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 radiant (2d8 at 14th).

name: Divine Strike
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 of the weapon's type (2d8 at 14th).

name: Divine Strike (Thunder)
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 thunder (2d8 at 14th).

name: Divine Strike (Poison)
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 poison (2d8 at 14th).

name: Divine Strike (Fire)
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 fire (2d8 at 14th).

name: Divine Strike (Psychic)
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 psychic (2d8 at 14th).

name: Potent Spellcasting
desc: Add WIS modifier to cleric cantrip damage.

name: Wild Shape
desc: Action: turn into a beast you have seen (CR 1/4 at 2nd, 1/2 at 4th, 1 at 8th). Two uses per short rest.

name: Combat Wild Shape
desc: Wild Shape as a bonus action.

name: Circle Forms
desc: Wild Shape into beasts up to CR 1 (CR = level / 3 from 6th).

name: Halo of Spores
desc: Reaction: a creature within 10 ft makes a CON save or takes 1d4 necrotic (grows with level).

name: Symbiotic Entity
desc: Use Wild Shape to gain 4 temp HP per druid level; Halo damage doubles and melee hits deal +1d6 necrotic.

name: Starry Form
desc: Use Wild Shape to take a starry form. Archer: bonus action 1d8 + WIS radiant ranged attack. Chalice: healing spells heal another creature 1d8 + WIS.

name: Second Wind
desc: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level HP. Once per short rest.

name: Action Surge
desc: Take one additional action. Once per short rest (twice at 17th).

name: Indomitable
desc: Reroll a failed saving throw (automatic). Once per long rest.

name: Improved Critical
desc: Weapon attacks crit on 19-20.

name: Superior Critical
desc: Weapon attacks crit on 18-20.

name: Combat Superiority
desc: Superiority dice fuel maneuvers: Precision (automatic), Riposte (automatic), Trip, Menacing, Pushing, Goading, Distracting (toggle before attacking).

name: Improved Combat Superiority
desc: Superiority dice become d10s.

name: War Magic
desc: After casting a cantrip, make a weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Weapon Bond
desc: Bond with weapons so you can't be disarmed and can summon them.

name: Fighting Spirit
desc: Bonus action: advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temp HP (10 at 10th, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

name: Unarmored Defense
desc: Without armor or shield, AC = 10 + DEX + WIS.

name: Martial Arts
desc: Use DEX for unarmed and monk weapons, martial arts damage die, and a bonus unarmed strike after attacking.

name: Ki
desc: Ki points fuel Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind. Recover on a short rest.

name: Unarmored Movement
desc: Bonus speed while unarmored.

name: Deflect Missiles
desc: Reaction: reduce ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + DEX + monk level (automatic).

name: Stunning Strike
desc: Spend 1 ki on a melee hit: target makes a CON save or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

name: Evasion
desc: DEX saves for half damage deal none on a success and half on a failure.

name: Open Hand Technique
desc: Flurry of Blows hits knock the target prone (DEX save).

name: Hand of Healing
desc: Spend 1 ki: touch heals a martial arts die + WIS.

name: Hand of Harm
desc: Once per turn, spend 1 ki on an unarmed hit for extra martial arts die + WIS necrotic.

name: Lay on Hands
desc: Action: heal from a pool of 5 x paladin level HP.

name: Divine Sense
desc: Sense celestials, fiends and undead nearby.

name: Divine Smite
desc: On a melee weapon hit, spend a spell slot for +2d8 radiant (+1d8 per slot level, +1d8 vs undead and fiends). Toggle it on the hotbar.

name: Improved Divine Smite
desc: Every melee weapon hit deals +1d8 radiant.

name: Aura of Protection
desc: You and allies within 10 ft add your CHA modifier to saving throws.

name: Aura of Courage
desc: You and allies within 10 ft can't be frightened.

name: Sacred Weapon
desc: Channel Divinity: add CHA to weapon attack rolls for 1 minute.

name: Vow of Enmity
desc: Channel Divinity (bonus action): advantage on attacks against one creature for 1 minute.

name: Nature's Wrath
desc: Channel Divinity: spectral vines restrain a creature (STR or DEX save).

name: Conquering Presence
desc: Channel Divinity: creatures within 30 ft make a WIS save or are frightened.

name: Turn the Unholy
desc: Channel Divinity (action): fiends and undead within 30 ft make a WIS save or are turned for 1 minute or until they take damage.

name: Turn the Faithless
desc: Channel Divinity (action): fey and fiends within 30 ft make a WIS save or are turned for 1 minute or until they take damage.

name: Abjure Enemy
desc: Channel Divinity (action): a creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save (fiends and undead at disadvantage). On a failure it is frightened with speed 0 for 1 minute or until it takes damage; on a success its speed is halved.

name: Aura of Devotion
desc: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) can't be charmed while you are conscious.

name: Colossus Slayer
desc: Once per turn, +1d8 damage against a creature below its max HP.

name: Dread Ambusher
desc: +WIS to initiative; on your first turn +10 ft speed and one extra attack dealing +1d8.

name: Planar Warrior
desc: Bonus action: mark a creature; your first hit on it each turn deals +1d8 force.

name: Dreadful Strikes
desc: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d4 psychic.

name: Gathered Swarm
desc: Once per turn, your swarm deals +1d6 piercing on a hit.

name: Favored Enemy
desc: Advantage on tracking and recalling lore about chosen enemies.

name: Sneak Attack
desc: Once per turn, deal extra d6s with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage or an ally is next to the target.

name: Cunning Action
desc: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

name: Uncanny Dodge
desc: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack that hits you (automatic on big hits).

name: Assassinate
desc: Advantage against creatures that haven't acted yet this combat.

name: Rakish Audacity
desc: +CHA to initiative; Sneak Attack a lone target with no one else adjacent to you.

name: Fancy Footwork
desc: Creatures you attack in melee can't make opportunity attacks against you this turn.

name: Font of Magic
desc: Sorcery points (one per sorcerer level). Bonus action: convert them into spell slots.

name: Metamagic
desc: Twist your spells: Quickened, Twinned, Empowered, Heightened, Careful, Distant.

name: Draconic Resilience
desc: +1 HP per sorcerer level; unarmored AC = 13 + DEX.

name: Elemental Affinity
desc: Add CHA to damage of your draconic ancestry's type.

name: Favored by the Gods
desc: Add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack (automatic). Once per short rest.

name: Pact Magic
desc: Few spell slots, always cast at their highest level, recovered on a short rest.

name: Eldritch Invocations
desc: Agonizing Blast, Repelling Blast, Eldritch Spear, Thirsting Blade, Lifedrinker, Eldritch Mind and more.

name: Pact Boon
desc: Pact of the Blade, Chain, Tome or Talisman.

name: Dark One's Blessing
desc: Reducing a hostile creature to 0 HP grants CHA + warlock level temp HP.

name: Hexblade's Curse
desc: Bonus action: curse a creature. +PB damage against it, crit on 19-20, and heal when it dies. Once per short rest.

name: Hex Warrior
desc: Use CHA for attack and damage with your weapon.

name: Healing Light
desc: Bonus action: spend d6s from a pool (1 + warlock level) to heal a creature within 60 ft.

name: Fey Presence
desc: Action: creatures within 10 ft make a WIS save or are frightened until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.

name: Arcane Recovery
desc: Recover spell slots on a short rest once per day.

name: Ritual Casting
desc: Cast ritual spells from your spellbook without preparing them.

name: Sculpt Spells
desc: Allies are untouched by your evocation spells' areas.

name: Potent Cantrip
desc: Creatures that save against your cantrips still take half damage.

name: Empowered Evocation
desc: Add INT to one damage roll of your wizard evocation spells.

name: Arcane Ward
desc: Casting abjuration spells builds a ward (2 x level + INT HP) that absorbs damage.

name: Grim Harvest
desc: Killing with a spell heals you 2 x spell level (3x for necromancy).

name: Bladesong
desc: Bonus action for 1 minute: +INT to AC and concentration saves, +10 ft speed. PB uses per long rest.

name: Tactical Wit
desc: Add INT to initiative.

name: Arcane Deflection
desc: Reaction: +2 AC against a hit or +4 to a failed save (automatic).

name: Wizardly Quill
desc: Summon a magic quill that copies spells quickly.

name: Awakened Spellbook
desc: When casting a wizard spell with a slot, swap its damage type for one from another spell of that level in your book.

name: Manifest Mind
desc: Project your spellbook's mind and cast spells from its space.

name: Master Scrivener
desc: Create a free upcast scroll after each long rest.

name: One with the Word
desc: Burn spells out of your book to cancel damage.

name: Temporal Awareness
desc: Add INT to initiative.

name: Chronal Shift
desc: Reaction: force a creature within 30 ft to reroll an attack, check or save. Two uses per long rest. Used automatically on enemy hits and ally failed saves.

name: Momentary Stasis
desc: Action: a Large or smaller creature within 60 ft makes a CON save or is incapacitated with 0 speed until the end of your next turn. INT mod uses per long rest.

name: Arcane Abeyance
desc: Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead for someone else to release.

name: Convergent Future
desc: Decide whether a roll succeeds or fails, taking exhaustion.
